name: Quantum computing task: Write a Qiskit program demonstrating entanglement distil
task_prompt: Quantum computing task: Write a Qiskit program demonstrating entanglement distillation (BBPSSW one round): start with two noisy Bell pairs (Werner states with fidelity 0.62 built via DensityMatrix), apply bilateral CNOT + post-selected measurement classically with numpy, and show the output fidelity exceeds the input. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
